page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A2.Flex.78-624 is a general-purpose virtual machine configuration based on the Arm-based Ampere AmpereOne processor architecture. The instance is provisioned with 156 dedicated physical cores operating at a fixed base frequency of 3.0 GHz. Each core supports a single hardware thread, ensuring no simultaneous multithreading overhead or cross-thread execution contention. System memory totals 624.0 GB, sustaining a balanced allocation ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Hardware acceleration via GPUs is not included on this instance type, and there is no bundled local NVMe storage. Consequently, operating system images, application installations, and persistent storage layers must be backed entirely by network-attached block storage services. Connectivity is provisioned with one complimentary public IPv4 address for ingress and administration.

The underlying AmpereOne architecture emphasizes compute density and consistent single-threaded deterministic performance across all 156 execution cores. By allocating dedicated single-threaded cores without hyperthreading, the server avoids CPU pipeline sharing, which provides predictable throughput for high-concurrency workloads while maintaining favorable cost efficiency per core.

VM.Standard.A2.Flex.78-624 is designed for highly parallel, horizontally scaled, and multi-threaded workloads optimized for the arm64 architecture. Key application profiles include massive container orchestration clusters, distributed continuous integration and compilation pipelines, enterprise web and application serving layers, and high-throughput batch data processing.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A2.Flex.78-624 is a general-purpose compute instance based on the 64-bit Arm Ampere AmpereOne processor family. It features 156 dedicated physical cores running at 3.0 GHz, with a single thread per core and no simultaneous multithreading overhead. Memory capacity is provisioned at 624.0 GB, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The server type contains no integrated GPUs and does not include local NVMe storage, relying on network-attached block storage for persistent file systems. One complimentary public IPv4 address is included. Operating on single-threaded dedicated Arm cores provides deterministic multi-core throughput and resource efficiency. VM.Standard.A2.Flex.78-624 is suited for large-scale parallel deployments including container clusters, distributed build systems, large-scale web services, and batch data processing workloads compiled for arm64 architectures.
